Priya Nair: Observed a weird failure mode on the int8 onboarding canary (sparrow-probe-int8): model sometimes emits a parseable JSON prefix, client retries, and we record duplicate external side-effects (email sends).
Alex Gomez: Any concrete trace?
Priya Nair: Example from traces:
```
REQ id=zz501 tool=send_notification
STREAM1: {"action":"send","to":"u@e.com","body":"Hi"}
<stream end>
client-sdk: parse-error -> retry
STREAM2: {"action":"send","to":"u@e.com","body":"Hi","msg_id":"m-900"}
```
Ibrahim Khan: So first chunk was actually valid JSON, but SDK flagged because no trailer/checksum. Retry fired and second full response arrived; backend performed tool twice.
Alex Gomez: Does float baseline do this?
Priya Nair: Baseline float has ~10x lower incidence. Correlates with quant kernel flushing small micro-batches early.
Ibrahim Khan: Proposed short-term mitigations: 1) runtime-side dedupe by idempotency_token with small TTL; 2) client SDK soft-accept for parseable JSON when contract contains required fields (e.g., action/status); 3) add an eval harness that injects artificial stream cuts and asserts single side-effect.
Alex Gomez: On runtime dedupe: we can record seen (idempotency_token, tool) for 5s in LRU cache and respond with cached result if duplicate. For hosted we can enable by default for configured side-effect routes. For Dedicated/Private, opt-in.
Priya Nair: SDK heuristic: if accumulated buffer JSON.parse succeeds AND message includes a contract-required key, treat as success unless explicit checksum present and indicates corruption. Put behind feature flag.
Ibrahim Khan: Also add server telemetry: duplicate_toolcall_rate per-model and structured_output_retry_rate. Gate canary rollout on those metrics.
ci-bot: Canary paused: sparrow-probe-int8 at 7% due to duplicate_toolcall_rate > 0.4%. Dashboard: https://ci.redwood/canaries/9012
Alex Gomez: Action owners: Priya - gather sample traces and open ticket; Ibrahim - runtime dedupe prototype; Naomi (cc) - SDK heuristic PR behind flag; Alex - add eval harness case for stream-cut chaos.
Priya Nair: Ticket created: https://tickets.redwood/ML-8200 (trace bundle attached).
Ibrahim Khan: Will prototype dedupe with LRU + TTL and measure memory; propose default TTL=5s, capacity 500k entries.
Priya Nair: Also add canary check that simulates 10k requests with 1% random chunk drop and assert no >1% duplicate side-effects.
ops-bot: Rollback available: /ops rollback sparrow-probe-int8. Ops standby if required. :white_check_mark:
Alex Gomez: Let's sync tomorrow after PRs. End thread.
